patches.patch_details: Replace forced 'geminiFlash' and mock executeGemini return with dynamic configuration checks and standard Google AI SDK execution wrapper with fallback checks.
Add 'reviewRequired: true' field to the semanticUnit object in Firestore when usedFallback is true. Enforce checking of this flag in promotion handlers.
Segregate attempts.isMockData from canonical student states, ensuring non-production client attempts are never written into production student collections.
Implement fail-closed validation guard checking AAF publication provenance signatures; block execution if placeholder parsing is invoked.
